## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "midwest_airbnb.db")
dbListTables(con)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r}
airbnb <- dbReadTable(con, "listings")
nrow(airbnb)
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM listings WHERE city = 'Columbus'")
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT name, price FROM listings WHERE city = 'Columbus' OR city='Chicago' ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5")
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT neighbourhood) FROM listings WHERE city = 'Chicago'")
```

```{r}
sum(airbnb$host_is_superhost == "t", na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
sum(airbnb$price > 1000)
```
